# wellplayed_identity_provider (Data Source)

Reads a WellPlayed organization identity provider (IdP). Backed by the `identityProvider` and `identityProviders` queries.

Look the provider up either by `id` or by `name` (exactly one must be set). A `name` lookup requires the name to be unique among the organization's identity providers.

The OAuth2/OpenID configuration carries the `client_secret` and is returned by the API only as an opaque union, so it is not exposed by this data source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up an identity provider by ID.
data "wellplayed_identity_provider" "by_id" {
  id = "idp_01h..."
}

# Look up an identity provider by its (unique) display name.
data "wellplayed_identity_provider" "by_name" {
  name = "Acme SSO"
}

# For example, derive a provider-scoped resource from the lookup.
output "acme_sso_enabled" {
  value = data.wellplayed_identity_provider.by_name.enabled
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the identity provider. Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be set.
- `name` (String) Display name of the identity provider. Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be set; a lookup by name requires the name to be unique.

### Read-Only

- `allow_login` (Boolean) Whether users can log in using this identity provider.
- `created_at` (String) When the identity provider was created (RFC 3339).
- `description` (String) Human-readable description of the identity provider.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether this identity provider is currently active.
- `icon` (String) URL or identifier for the provider icon.
- `identity_provider_id` (String) ID of the root identity provider this provider is derived from, if any.
- `organization_id` (String) ID of the organization this provider belongs to.
- `required_for_player_validation` (Boolean) Whether player accounts must be validated through this provider.
- `updated_at` (String) When the identity provider was last updated (RFC 3339).
